title: WTA.Next Secure Learning Platform Prototype
summary: Built a runnable end-to-end learning-platform prototype that joined secure single sign-on, access-aware discovery, and click-through delivery across real services. It turned the target architecture into an executable proof, validating identity, search, and learning-system integration together.

title: WiseTech Academy LMS Architecture
summary: Defined and delivered LMS architecture across billing, integrations, proctoring, and CI/CD foundations, improving platform extensibility and release reliability.

title: WiseTech Academy Content Platform Convergence
summary: Led architecture and hands-on delivery across authoring, content, and delivery streams for WiseTech Academy, including live CMS modernisation, a canonical reusable-content model, and a governed content-as-code path. The resulting approach supports publish-once, reference-everywhere delivery with versioned lesson containers rather than duplicated course material.

title: WiseTech Academy Packaging and Validation Pipeline
summary: Drove a schema-led content pipeline through validation, reference integrity, external asset migration, and SCORM packaging so academy content could move from design intent to repeatable build and release workflows.

title: CargoWise Integration and ETL Orchestration
summary: Designed and built ETL-driven XML integration workflows between CargoWise and external ecosystems including customs, government agencies, ocean liners, and air transport providers.

title: Platform Delivery and Container Operations
summary: Worked across containerised delivery and platform operations using Docker, Quay, Argo CD, OpenShift, and CI/CD deployment pipelines to move applications from local engineering environments into repeatable hosted runtime paths.

title: Orbitra Product Suite
summary: Designing, building, and operating a private production suite spanning shared identity, financial workflows, media governance, and structured learning. The platform combines trusted access, clear workflows, reusable digital assets, and reliable CI/CD-backed delivery.

title: Orbitra Media Library
summary: Built an identity-aware media library for reusable images, video, and documents, combining contributor workflows, metadata and usage-rights management, signed asset delivery, lifecycle history, and reversible archive controls.

title: Orbitra Skills Dojo
summary: Built a production learning and authoring environment with public discovery, member learning, learner progress, and Sensei content administration, structured around a governed skill ontology.
